footnotes: Superseded: this run is not in the published table; the run measured on 2026-11-12/13 (`data/2026/cycle-3/beszel.*`) replaces it. The unit was charged 16.6 MB of disk writes between 13 minutes and 7.0 hours after the install (15.1 MB per 24 h in the idle window) and nothing after. Checks on the bed's boxes on 2026-11-12 showed the mechanism: ext4 writes its metadata through the block device's inode, 2 to 2.7 MB per hour on an idle box, and the kernel charges all writeback of one inode to a single cgroup, whichever owns it. That this unit's cgroup owned it for those hours is inferred from the matching rate and write sizes, because the box had been rebuilt before the check; the agent's page cache stayed at 16,384 bytes for the whole run and its on-disk footprint at the end equals runs 1 and 2. `docs/RUN-2026-slot5.md` has the evidence and the rule under which the run was replaced.
